execution.description: Retried the affected Cooling and Graphite suites through the canonical wrapper after removing the ignored Windows pytest cache.

expected: The clean copy should bootstrap and run pytest in the pinned Linux container.
observed: The source copy completed, but bootstrap refused because this Windows-created linked worktree's .git file names a Windows absolute Git directory that is not a valid path inside the Linux container. Pytest did not start.
keep: Keep the source worktree unchanged; the refusal is environmental, not a product-code result.
change: Stage the same tree in a disposable native-Linux Git clone and run the canonical wrapper there.
